plan.reason: With 10D and only 24/100 evaluations, sample density is very sparse, so auto surrogate selection balances RBF flexibility against a quadratic fallback via held-out RMSE. A moderate population (30) and 5 generations keep each surrogate fit cheap while producing enough candidates; current_to_best gives focused movement toward the incumbent with mutation 0.6 for diversity. Exploration 0.3 and local_fraction 0.25 with radius 0.15 favor broad coverage early (novelty is a heuristic, not uncertainty) while reserving a small local search fraction, appropriate since no progress has been observed yet and over-exploiting a poorly fit surrogate is risky.
